workflow_remeasurement.limits: Three runs per group, one implementation task, no matched random seeds. Observed differences do not establish a general causal quality benefit.
workflow_remeasurement.coverage: One fixed SuperJSON implementation task; does not evaluate the newly supported investigation, architecture collaboration, document, test-only or measurement-only outcomes.
workflow_remeasurement.completion: The isolated native sessions do not expose the Codex app send_message_to_thread tool. The installed workflow explicitly handles unavailable delivery by reporting that limit. These runs do not validate app-tool notification delivery.
